conflicts.description: The showcase mockup's sidebar shows exactly 4 items (Dashboard, Courses, Users, Categories) — omitting Instructors.
conflicts.resolution: product/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md § 28 defines a full 'Admin — Manage Instructors' screen as locked MVP scope, and shared/navigation.json#/shells/adminWeb (locked Product/UX precedence over Showcase) lists 5 items including Instructors. The implementation correctly keeps Instructors in the sidebar — the showcase's 4-item version is not reproduced.

conflicts.description: The showcase mockup shows a bidirectional Toggle control in the Status column (implying Admin can both publish and unpublish).
conflicts.resolution: backend/.../courses/routes/CourseRoutes.kt grants Admin only the 'unpublish' course mutation (Role.instructor, Role.admin) — there is no admin-capable publish endpoint. Reproducing a bidirectional Toggle would fabricate a capability the backend does not offer. The implementation instead renders a read-only status Badge plus a one-way 'Unpublish' row action on published courses only, consistent with product/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md § 26 ('Unpublish' as the only primary action) and the info banner text sourced verbatim from the showcase itself ('no submission queue and no approval or rejection step').

layout.structure: title + course-count subtitle -> info banner -> search/status filter bar -> DataTable of all courses across instructors

content: subtitle: '{total} courses · {published} published' sourced from AdminDashboard stats
Info-tone banner: 'Admin can view, manage, and unpublish a course. There is no submission queue and no approval or rejection step.' — verbatim from showcase § 16
Status Select (All/Published/Draft) — client-side filter, no backend status query param exists

Conditional Badge + 'Clear filter' TextButton when arriving via '?instructor=' from Manage Instructors 'View courses' row action — client-side name-match filter, no backend instructor query param exists
DataTable: Course(title, link to read-only course view), Instructor name, Status Badge, Enrollment count — row action 'Unpublish' (published courses only) with confirm dialog

artworkRules: n/a — DataTable rows, no course-thumbnail artwork on this screen.
rtlBehavior: table headers/columns, filter bar, and row-action popover mirror per logical properties
themeBehavior: standard semantic token resolution; info banner uses color.info.container/onInfoContainer tokens
responsiveRules: shared/responsive.json#/perSurfaceRules/dataTable — collapses to stacked cards below the DataTable component-spec breakpoint (see knownGaps)
knownGaps: design-system/COMPONENTS.md (DataTable collapses below 'desktop') and design-system/design-tokens.json (collapses below 'tablet') genuinely disagree on the collapse breakpoint. Resolved in favor of the more detailed component-specific prose (COMPONENTS.md). Disclosed, non-blocking. See execution/DECISIONS_LOG.md D62.

The collapsed stacked-card breakpoint could not be live-verified in this session's browser automation environment (resize_window reports success but does not change the actual rendered viewport/window.innerWidth here) — verified by code review against the DataTable component implementation only, not by live screenshot at a narrow viewport.

Neither the Admin/instructor-filter nor the status filter has a backend query parameter (backend/.../admin/service/AdminService.kt's listCourses takes no instructor or status param) — both are implemented as disclosed, backend-contract-respecting client-side filters (fetched with a larger single-page limit when active), not invented backend capabilities.
